steps.summary: Simulated call Kasper Kovelund. Yes, I am still safe at the service-area car park, and the Bentley is parked with the engine off. I have not given the exact name or direction yet, so I will send you a location pin from the app now. Not yet.

input.text: The driver says they are still safe at a service-area car park with the Bentley parked and the engine off, and will stay with it until told who is collecting.
Exact stop location is unknown: no service-area name or pin yet (the driver says a pin is coming now), and the last app position is 4 h old, about 233 km before Hamburg.
The dashboard warning photo has not been sent yet; the driver says it comes right after the pin. Nobody has diagnosed the red warning.
The customer asked us to keep the car stopped and is checking with their service contact whether it needs roadside help or collection. No answer yet.
The delivery promise of 21 Oct 13:00–17:00 will almost certainly be missed while the car is stopped about 233 km out with no recovery plan.
No recovery, tow or travel is booked or quoted.

draft_message.body: Call brief: the Bentley Continental GT on CD-420322 stopped this morning after a red dashboard warning and reduced acceleration. The driver, Kasper Kovelund, is safe at a service-area car park with the engine off and is staying with the car. The exact location pin and the warning photo are on their way from the driver; we have no diagnosis. Ask: (1) roadside help, collection, or safe custody? (2) Who is the named collector or service company, and when will they arrive? (3) Do they cover the cost, or should Bahn arrange it? Say the delivery today (13:00–17:00 Helsinki time) will be missed and that a new estimate comes once recovery is agreed. Do not agree to anyone driving the car.

input.what_happens_next: Once you approve, a person calls the customer with this brief. I keep the driver stopped and pass on the pin and photo when they arrive.
input.what_happens_after: The customer's recovery choice is recorded. The driver is told who is collecting the car, and a separate proposal then replans the driver and the delivery date.
